newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swaps-Gas oil down on low India award.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swaps-Gas oil down on low India award.

text.p: Singapore gas oil swaps fell mid-morning on Friday on an unexpectedly low award by state-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) for its June delivery cargoes, traders said.
"The market is bearish because of the low award but nothing has traded so far," one broker said.
May swaps were last quoted at $25.25/$25.35, down from Wednesday's $25.55/$25.65, brokers said.
On Wednesday, May traded at an intra-day high of $25.57 before it eased to trade at $25.50 and $25.45, they said.
Traders said prices came off because the market had on Wednesday expected IOC to buy around 600,000 tonnes compared to the 315,000 tonnes awarded.
"The award is very small. The market should be down because of this," one trader said.
